title: Vegan Swede and Miso Tagine Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful vegan stew from the inspiration of North African tagine, featuring swede and miso.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the swede, miso paste, and Ethiopian.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the swede is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
